title: Drift Away Vacation Rental
meta_description: Drift Away is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionDrift AwaySeacrest Beach Area of 30A – Magnolia Cottages by the SeaPatina Blvd., Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Home HighlightsPrivate Deeded Beach Access4 Bedrooms (see room configurations under “Room Details”)4.5 Bathrooms2,160 sq. ft.Sleeps up to 14 guestsLarge Screened-In PorchSpacious Living Area with 55" TVFully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast BarDining Area6-Seater Golf Cart IncludedFull-Size Washer and DryerOutdoor ShowerComplimentary High-Speed Wi-FiGas GrillFour 26" Adult Bikes Included Seasonally (Bikes not available Dec–Feb; additional rentals available)Seacrest Beach – close to Rosemary Beach & Alys BeachProperty DescriptionDrift Away is a serene retreat in the Magnolia Cottages by the Sea community, offering the perfect blend of coastal charm and modern amenities. Located in the scenic Seacrest Beach, this home provides plenty of space for family or friends with four bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms.Step outside to enjoy your private deeded beach access, just moments from the sparkling Gulf waters of 30A. After a day in the sun, relax at the community’s resort-style pool surrounded by a tranquil, wooded setting. Drift Away’s inviting living spaces, screened-in porch, and convenient amenities make it the ideal choice for your next beach getaway.Community AmenitiesResort-Style Pool with Ample SeatingBeach Access across from Neighborhood Entrance or via Seabreeze BeachWalk or Bike to Rosemary Beach & Alys Beach1 Mile to The Big Chill RestaurantNatural Preserve Feel with Plenty of ShadeParking2 cars in the driveway1 car in front of the homeGolf Cart PolicyGolf carts are allowed in the community and must be street-legal with a valid tag/license plate. Carts must fit in the home’s designated parking area along with guest vehicles and cannot be parked on streets or lawns.Reservation & Booking PolicyThe cancellation policy and terms in the 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement override any third-party booking site policies (VRBO, HomeAway, Airbnb, etc.).Service fees from third-party bookings are non-refundable.No 100% refunds after booking; a 5% cancellation fee applies to cover credit card and document processing.Optional travel insurance is available; must be purchased before final payment.Additional PoliciesNo SmokingNo Pets (except certified service animals; documentation required)Published rates do not include taxes and fees50% due at booking; balance due 60 days before arrival (or in full if within 60 days)Check-In: 6:00 PM | Check-Out: 12:00 PM (Starting Jan 1, 2026: Check-In 4:00 PM / Check-Out 10:00 AM)Guests must be 25 years or older; reservations cannot be made by or for anyone under 25
